title: Kumeyaay Lake Campground

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: June 1-June 26, 2026 9AM-4PM with optional extended camp hours from 8:30AM-4:30PM Week 1 (June 1 - June 5): Explorers of Mission Trails (One 6-8 spots available and two 9-11 spots available) Week 2 (June 8 - June 12): Habitats, Ecosystems, and Wildlife (SOLD OUT) Week 3 (June 15 - June 19): Nature through Art and Story (SOLD OUT) Week 4 (June 22 - June 26): Mission Trails Junior Scientists (SOLD OUT) The weeklong day camps are designed for two age groups (6-8-year-olds and 9-11-year-olds), with age-appropriate activities that encourage curiosity, teamwork, and hands-on learning. Most of the camp activities will take place at the park’s Visitor Center, located at 1 Father Junipero Serra

blurb: The Kumeyaay Lake Campground is open for Friday and Saturday night camping. The 46 campsites are available for reservation on a first-come, first-serve basis and the cost is $22.78 per night.
